newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Volatile Pibor to find support at 96.30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Volatile Pibor to find support at 96.30.

text.p: June Pibor futures will swing wildly ahead of a snap election in France, but there is a firm buffer on the downside, analysts said on Tuesday.
"There is strong support at 96.30," said a French broker in Paris. "It's very volatile but there have been some good buyers this morning," he added.
June Pibor was 0.12 above Monday's 96.41 close at 0718 GMT.

But the market has fallen steeply as political developments emerged, having hovered around 96.70 early last week. The mood is nervous, analysts said, after President Jacques Chirac called an early election on Monday.
Chirac called an election for May 25 and June 1, seen as a base for pushing through austerity measures ahead of European economic and monetary union (EMU).

More support for Pibor is at 96.25, the French broker said. "Resistance is difficult to see but there is some at the current level of 96.41/42," the French broker added. Above that, 96.52 offers a shelf.
"People sold off last week because of the possibility of an election -- we have had short notice of it," the broker said.
The break of 96.43 on Monday was key, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a note for clients.
The 96.43 level was a 23 percent retracement of gains since June 1996, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
"This signals resumption of long-term retreat to 96.16 retracement, and to 95.95."
